Army Customisation allows you to further individualise your force. Archetypes change how you build your army by moving around units in the Army Organisation Plan (AOP) or letting you take more of a unit than you would normally be allowed to. Legacies give access to armories and disciplines of legendary factions. Traits enhance your units with special abilities that they normally would not be able to have.

You may select up to the following:
0-1 Archetype, 0-1 Legacy, 0-2 Traits

If a Trait is taken, all models / units in the army must be upgraded with it, unless stated otherwise.

- With the exception of Dark Reapers, <Aspect> units can be taken as Troops.
- Non-<Aspect> Troops become Elite choices.
- All Exarchs must gain two Exarch powers and they are no longer unique.

- The army got access to a single Vindicare assassin.
- One HQ selection must be a Farseer.

- Windriders can be taken as Troops.
- All units with less than 12" Movement must start the game as passengers inside a transport.
- Units that have no transport option and less than 12" Movement cannot be taken at all.

- Wraithblades and Wraithguard units can be taken as Troops.
- For every 4 Wraithblade or every 3 Wraithguard models, one Wraithlord unit can be taken as Troops.
- Non-<Wraith> Troops become Elite choices.

- Ynnari become "Battle Brothers" for Dark Eldar.
- The army got access to the Ynnari Armory and the Revenant discipline.
- May not select any Legacy.
The army has access to equipment from the Alaitoc Craftworld in the Craftworld Armory.
The army has access to equipment from the Ulthwé Craftworld in the Craftworld Armory.
The army has access to equipment from the Iyanden Craftworld in the Craftworld Armory.
The army has access to equipment from the Biel-Tan Craftworld in the Craftworld Armory.
The army has access to equipment from the Saim-Hann Craftworld in the Craftworld Armory.
The unit gains the "Deadly(6+)" ability for all melee weapons.
If the unit is below starting strength, each model in it gains +1 attack.
The unit may re-roll 1s and 2s for manifestating or denying psychic powers. Only for Psykers.
The army must select a second Legacy. Each model may only select items from one Legacy armory.
The unit may re-roll one to hit roll per activation.
The unit may re-roll one to wound or armor penetration roll per activation.
Every melee combat result is increased by +2 for the unit.
The "Shuriken" ability grants an additional -1 to the weapon's AP value.
The unit gains the "Sunder(1)" ability for all ranged attacks.
The unit gains the benefit of light cover until its first activation.
If the unit disembarked from a transport this round, all of its weapons gain the "Decimate" ability for this activation.
If the unit uses a Charge order or gets charged by an enemy unit, all of its melee weapons gain -1 AP for this activation.
The unit ignores temporary vehicle damage on a roll of 4+.
The point costs for traits have to be paid per unit. If point costs are marked with *, then they must be paid for every Wound or Hull point in the unit.
